name: Fake EigenLayer Token
rootCause: There is an exit scam on a fake EigenLayer token. The deployer profited ~$300k. BSC: 0x14ac066ac2CD24CBdE31f78659c11F13aB61E4e7.

descriptions.text: There is an exit scam on a fake EigenLayer token. The deployer profited ~$300k. BSC: 0x14ac066ac2CD24CBdE31f78659c11F13aB61E4e7.

A fake EigenLayer BEP20 token on BNB Chain drained PancakeSwap liquidity in multiple withdrawals between September and October 2023. Verified BscScan transactions show the deployer pulling BNB through the PancakeSwap router, and incident trackers place the total loss at about 3,802 BNB, or $821,232. A copycat BEP20 token reused the EigenLayer name and the deployer kept control of the PancakeSwap liquidity. That control let the wallet remove liquidity through the router in repeated withdrawals. No vulnerable contract code has been identified in the available public evidence, so this is best treated as an impersonation and liquidity-control rug pull, not a protocol exploit.
